== Strategy ==

start with holotable. draw cards until you get a reactor terminal and play a hologram asap to the holotable to drain. after terminal is in play and you have a hologram in play keep throwing back your holograms into the deck (destiny 6 & 7) to keep them in your deck. use counter assaults to counter some of their force drains as long as you canh make them lose force for sure, otherwise just lose the force.please rate this deck and give me some comments.
